title: 'Human in the loop': How a man, woman and their affair affected AI stocks – the Jensen Huang aftermath for Nvidia and others
description: Nvidia lost about $476 billion in two days after Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair, while stocks of rival chip firms like AMD and Broadcom rose. SoftBank and neoclouds face indirect risk from the Nvidia scandal amid a wider AI valuation reset.

title: CoreWeave raises 2026 revenue forecast amid growing demand for AI infrastructure
description: Driven by a growing need for AI-focused hardware, CoreWeave has revised its financial forecasts for 2026 upwards, sending its share price up nearly 13% in after-hours trading. The company now expects annual revenue of between $13 billion and $13.3 billion (€11.6-11.9 billion), exceeding the previous market consensus of $12.9 billion (€11.5 billion). title: AI hoaxes are deceiving 911 dispatchers, and they're only getting harder to detect
description: Swatters are increasingly using AI technology that creates synthetic voices or sound effects to generate remarkably believable fake emergency calls to law enforcement.
